description: IA-50A c/n 32 (ex LV-LAM, second T-111) rebuilt with the identity of T-122 c/n 14, the first Argentine-built aircraft to land at Port Stanley (February 1973); retired April 1999 and left completely vandalised and derelict at the abandoned San Justo aerodrome. Photographed January 2018, September 2020; described as in advanced decay in June 2026.
